change.rationale: Rejected students only get the reason inside the message text. Enrollment already stores the machine-readable reason (enrollment.types.ts Enrollment.reason; enrollment.service.ts enroll()), but Notification (notification.types.ts) has no such field, so the web page cannot show it. Add a nullable reason attribute to the Notification data, set only on enrollment-rejected notifications, and describe the web page showing it. Left unchanged on purpose: Enrollment data, seat-limit rule, module dependencies (mod-notifications stays dependency-free, so the reason is typed string there like Enrollment.reason, not a reference), no events/contracts, confirmed enrollments and their notifications, capabilities, and the message texts.

request.behavior: When an enrollment is rejected, the notification created for the student carries the rejection reason (COURSE_FULL or ALREADY_ENROLLED) in a new optional `reason` field, returned by GET /notifications, and the web page shows that reason next to the rejected notification. Confirmed notifications have no reason.
acceptanceCriteria: A COURSE_FULL rejection produces a notification with reason COURSE_FULL, and the message text is unchanged
An ALREADY_ENROLLED rejection produces a notification with reason ALREADY_ENROLLED
A confirmed enrollment's notification has no reason field and is otherwise unchanged
GET /api/notifications returns the reason for rejected notifications
The web page shows the reason next to a rejected notification and nothing extra for confirmed ones
The notifications module does not import from the enrollment module (no new module dependency)
